meta.title: PartyWatcher — watch movies and videos together online
meta.description: PartyWatcher is a free watch-party service. Create a room, send the link to your friends and watch YouTube, Twitch and other videos in sync, with chat and voice.
meta.ogDescription: Create a room, send the link to your friends and watch videos in sync with chat and voice.

intro.title: Watch movies and videos together with friends
intro.text: PartyWatcher is an online watch-party service. Create a room, share the link, and everyone watches the same video in sync: YouTube, Twitch, Google Drive and other sources. Rooms have text chat and voice.

info.youtube_twitch:
Paste a YouTube video link (youtube.com/watch?v=... or youtu.be/...) or a Twitch recording (VOD) link (twitch.tv/videos/1234567890 — a recording, not a live stream).
The type is detected automatically from the link.
info.drive:
(not tested)
In Google Drive: right-click the video → "Share" → "Anyone with the link" → copy the link and paste it here. Otherwise the server cannot read the file.
info.player_capture:
Paste a link to a movie/series page. Optimized for:
• Kinogo(https://kinogo2026.com), (https://kinogomy.net),
• Rezka (https://rezka-ua.tv), () https://rezka.ag
• (https://ga.lordfilm5.pro), (https://lordfilm.fi) and their possible mirror domains (there may be quirks, but movies/series should work).
Other sites may work too, but this is not guaranteed.
⚠️ my.mail.ru is not supported (it cannot be captured).
Some sites let you choose the season/episode/voice-over/player.
info.direct:
Paste a READY direct video link — a regular site page address will NOT work here (e.g. a my.mail.ru watch page), only:
• a link to the video file itself: .mp4, .m3u8
• a link to an embed player that the site ITSELF allows to embed (not all sites allow it, e.g. my.mail.ru).
Such a link usually has to be found in the page source — the server does not look for it, unlike "Player capture".

privacy.public: 🔓 Public — the room will appear in "Public rooms" for all users.
privacy.private: 🔒 Private — the room is not listed anywhere, it can only be joined with its key.
